By combining the data from these techniques, I can deduce the structure and determine the SMILES notation. I will start by obtaining the mass spectrometry, 1H NMR, and 13C NMR spectra in parallel, as these are the most informative for structural elucidation.

The molecular formula \( \text{C}_{10}\text{H}_{13}\text{NO}_2 \) suggests a structure with aromatic characteristics and possibly an amine or amide group, given the presence of nitrogen and oxygen. Among the valid SMILES, the one that fits this description and is a common structure is:
